# `notification_message`

Area: **notifications** ([all tables](README.md))

One customer message (TMF681 CommunicationMessage): what was sent, to whom, on which channel and in which state. Created once per event (dedupe_key) by the notification worker or by an operator, sent through the notify adapter.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `event_type` | `text` | no |  | The event that caused it (low_balance, renewal_done, grace, usage_80, ...) or operator for a message made through the API. |
| `category` | `text` | no |  | transactional (always allowed) or marketing (only with a recorded opt-in on the customer, TCPA). |
| `channel` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `template` | `text` | no |  | The template that rendered the content, <event type>.<channel>; operator for a hand-written message. |
| `state` | `text` | no |  | TMF681 state: initial (queued, or waiting for quiet hours to end), inProgress (a send failed, a retry is scheduled), completed (sent), cancelled (not sent: see state_reason), failed (retries used up). |
| `state_reason` | `text` | yes |  | Why a message was cancelled: noConsent (marketing without opt-in), noRecipient (no address on the channel), operator. |
| `receiver_name` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `receiver_email` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `receiver_phone` | `text` | yes |  | SMS destination as E.164 digits without plus: the customer's phone contact medium, else the line's MSISDN. |
| `customer_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `subject` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `content` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `description` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `priority` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `sender` | `jsonb` | yes |  | The TMF681 sender as an operator sent it; the adapter uses the configured sender. |
| `dedupe_key` | `text` | yes |  | Identity of the event the message is for (for example usage:<product>:<period>:<allowance>:<80\|100>): the unique key with the channel makes a repeated worker tick create nothing twice. Null for an operator message and for a resend. |
| `scheduled_send_time` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Earliest send time: the end of the SMS quiet hours for a message created inside them. |
| `send_time` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When the first send attempt was made. |
| `send_time_complete` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When the adapter accepted the message. |
| `try_times` | `integer` | no | `0` | Send attempts made so far. |
| `next_attempt_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When the worker sends or retries it (backoff 1, 5, 15, 60 minutes); null once final. |
| `last_error` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `provider_ref` | `text` | yes |  | The adapter's reference of the accepted message. |
| `resend_of` | `uuid` | yes |  | The message this one repeats (an operator resend). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `notification_message_category_check` | check | `CHECK ((category = ANY (ARRAY['transactional'::text, 'marketing'::text])))` |
| `notification_message_channel_check` | check | `CHECK ((channel = ANY (ARRAY['sms'::text, 'email'::text])))` |
| `notification_message_check` | check | `CHECK (((state = 'cancelled'::text) = (state_reason IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `notification_message_check1` | check | `CHECK (((state <> 'completed'::text) OR (send_time_complete IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `notification_message_check2` | check | `CHECK (((state = 'cancelled'::text) OR ((channel = 'sms'::text) AND (receiver_phone IS NOT NULL)) OR ((channel = 'email'::text) AND (receiver_email IS NOT NULL))))` |
| `notification_message_dedupe_key_check` | check | `CHECK ((dedupe_key <> ''::text))` |
| `notification_message_event_type_check` | check | `CHECK ((event_type <> ''::text))` |
| `notification_message_receiver_phone_check` | check | `CHECK ((receiver_phone ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'::text))` |
| `notification_message_sender_check` | check | `CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(sender) = 'object'::text))` |
| `notification_message_state_check` | check | `CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['initial'::text, 'inProgress'::text, 'completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'failed'::text])))` |
| `notification_message_template_check` | check | `CHECK ((template <> ''::text))` |
| `notification_message_try_times_check` | check | `CHECK ((try_times >= 0))` |
| `notification_message_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
| `notification_message_dedupe_key_channel_key` | unique | `UNIQUE (dedupe_key, channel)` |
